title: 2027 GRAMMYs: Rosalía, Ella Langley, and Raye Lead Nominees List
summary: The nominations for the 2027 GRAMMY Awards, airing February 7, have been announced and Raye, Rosalía are the top contenders in this year's ceremony.
body_markdown:
Music’s biggest night is celebrating the ladies.


The nominees for the 69th annual GRAMMY Awards were announced on November 16, and the women dominated each category. Raye leads the pack with 11 nominations for her sophomore album, “This Music May Contain Hope,” scoring nods in each of the four major categories.


Following close behind is Rosalía, who has nine nominations, including the Album of the Year and Record of the Year categories. Phoebe Bridgers, Miranda Lambert, Ella Langley and Olivia Rodrigo each have seven.


Olivia Dean, Bruno Mars, and Leon Thomas have six, followed by Taylor Swift Geese, and Kehlani with five total nominations. Madonna, Cardi B, Brandi Carlile, Ariana Grande, and Kacey Musgraves close out the leads with four each.


Ella Langley—who found chart-topping success with “Choosin’ Texas” faces off against Geese, Angine de Poitrine, Slayyyter, Don Toliver, Remi Wolf, Sienna Spiro, and The Womack Sisters for Best New Artist.


No stranger to making history, Beyoncé—who holds the record as the most awarded artist in GRAMMYs history with 35 wins—became the first artist to achieve 100 nominations in the course of their career, with the entry of her song “Morning Dew (Donk)” in the Best R&B Solo Performance category.


The 2027 GRAMMYs air February 7, live from Crypto.com area in Los Angeles at 7pm ET.


Listen to music by the nominees throughout the day on your favorite SiriusXM channels or by searching their names in the[app](https://sxm.app.link/Blog2027GrammyNominees) .


For the full list of nominees for the 2027 GRAMMY Awards visit[grammy.com](https://www.grammy.com/) .
